spec_match.rationale: Probes and calls the exact explainer IDL surface: appendHTML/prependHTML/beforeHTML/afterHTML/replaceWithHTML (+Unsafe) and setHTML/setHTMLUnsafe, mapped to the exact insertAdjacentHTML/outerHTML/innerHTML calls they supersede.

interactive.rationale: Live stage (alpha/TARGET/omega) with position select, safe/unsafe radios, markup textarea, insert/reset, and a support matrix of 12 live typeof probes that can and do return undefined.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Feature-index blurb promises probing + calling the ten positional setters with the legacy mapping; the page delivers exactly that.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers: unsupported method (honest no-insert message), safe-variant-has-no-legacy-equivalent, TARGET destroyed by replaceWith (reset flow), and older engines throwing on the renewed options dictionary (caught, retried 1-arg, reported in the readout).

references.rationale: Page links https://chromestatus.com/feature/5054329641893888 plus the explainer section it demonstrates.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite asserts typeof for four positional methods plus the passing ShadowRoot.setHTMLUnsafe baseline; fails honestly on Chromium 141 (verified 2 pass / 8 fail, all executing cleanly).

runtime_evidence.rationale: Verified in headless Chromium 141 (this sandbox has no Chrome 153/Canary): initial probes, unsupported-path fallbacks, and the genuinely-working legacy/baseline branches were exercised via ?autorun=1 with screenshots, DOM dumps and CDP console/network capture (zero errors; the single fonts.googleapis.com stylesheet failure is environmental). The flag-enabled success paths could not be executed on any available browser and remain unverified.

telemetry_health.rationale: showcaseTelemetry.assert() fires after each primary action; unsupported/fallback branches assert under distinct ids (…-fallback / …-illustration) and are never reported as feature passes.

design_system.rationale: Only design-system CSS variables; emerald success surfaces use --text-black text (5.1:1, AA) after an explicit contrast audit; rose surfaces use --bg-ivory (5.26:1); secondary buttons override background AND color together; no static code-card pattern.

accessibility.rationale: Native select/radio/textarea/button controls with label wrapping, fieldset+legend for the variant group, aria-live polite status, visible :focus-visible outlines, th scope on matrix headers.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: CDP device emulation matrix (mobile 360x740 DPR3 touch + desktop 1280x800): no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth==innerWidth both classes), 44px control heights, visible focus outlines, aria-live status, zero console errors on both classes.

openQuestions.question: Run the insert flow on Chrome/Canary 153 with --enable-blink-features=NewHTMLSettingMethods,SetHTMLCanRunScripts,TrustedTypesCreateParserOptions and confirm each of the 12 methods inserts at the right position and the safe variants sanitize.

The feature is proposal-stage (ChromeStatus status: Proposed); re-check the shipped method names against the explainer's #resulting-api section when 153 reaches Canary — the demo and conformance suite must track any renames additively.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel buttons mobile no horizontal overflow tap targets
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Constrain form controls to their container (width/min-width/box-sizing) and keep touch targets comfortably large on mobile.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All controls are >=2.75rem (44px) tall; at <=640px controls get width:100%, min-width:0 and box-sizing:border-box so selects/textareas cannot widen the layout viewport. Verified via CDP mobile emulation (360x740 DPR3): documentElement.scrollWidth == innerWidth == 360.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: scratchpad CDP matrix run 2026-07-26: scrollWidth 360 / innerWidth 360, zero console errors

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible live region announcing async progress and error states
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce async state changes through a polite live region with text equivalents; keep rapid progress updates out of the live region.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Each page has a single aria-live=polite <output> status for state changes; the streaming page keeps per-chunk progress in a separate non-live text line so screen readers are not flooded; verdict panels carry full text, not colour alone.

guidanceConsulted.query: streaming progressive HTML rendering into container without layout shift
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Reserve space for content that arrives late/progressively to avoid layout shift.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The streaming stage reserves min-height:10rem so chunk arrival does not shift the controls or status region below it.

summary: Insertion lab drives the exact renewed positional API with honest per-method typeof probes (1/12 present on Chromium 141 — setHTMLUnsafe only), a working legacy-equivalent illustration path, and an options-dictionary compatibility shim that reports itself. Flag-supported success paths remain unverified pending a 153 browser.
